newsitem.title: USA: Valero to shut Texas MTBE plant for 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Valero to shut Texas MTBE plant for 10 days.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said Thursday it will shut down its Corpus Christi, Texas, MTBE plant for about 10 days to change a catalyst.
Shut down at the about 16,000 barrel-per-day plant is to begin on Monday, Jan. 13, to change a spent catalyst in one of the plant's oleflex units.
The company, which does not disclose its production rates, said it has enough MTBE in supply to cover its commitments.
News of the cut had little impact on the MTBE market, which was drifting down on Thursday amid weakening NYMEX gasoline futures, quiet trade and ample supply.
